Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.annotations

package eu.cloudhopper.mc.annotations
Provides annotations for declaring cloud functions and API metadata.

Application developers annotate plain methods to describe how their functions should be deployed and integrated; the annotation processor generates the provider-specific handlers and deployment artifacts.

Function and trigger annotations (applied to a method):

  • Function - marks a method as a deployable function
  • ScheduledTrigger - defines a time-based (cron) trigger
  • HttpTrigger - adds HTTP metadata for API gateway integration
Parameter-binding annotations (applied to a method parameter):
  • RequestBody - binds the deserialized request body
  • PathParam - binds a URI path template variable
  • QueryParam - binds a query string parameter
  • HeaderParam - binds an HTTP request header
Vendor extensions:
  • Extension / Extensions - attach provider-specific attributes (see ExtensionKeys)
